news.title: Six Unpatched Danfoss Refrigeration Controller Flaws Could Allow Remote Takeover Without Login
news.detail: Six flaws in Danfoss AK-SM800A refrigeration controllers could let a remote attacker take over a controller without logging in, Dutch security consultancy Midnight Blue said earlier this week. No patch is available, and the researchers say…

news.title: Retadup Worm Resurfaces 7 Years After Takedown to Spread CoffeeLoader Malware
news.detail: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a new variant of CoffeeLoader, a malware designed to deliver additional payloads to infected machines. "On launch, the NSIS-based installer executable dropped a file named '7z.dll' into a…
